name: Grilled Brown Sugar-Chili Steak with Cucumber, Pepper & Snap Pea Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a large baking dish along with soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Pat steak dry with paper towels and add to the baking dish with the marinade; turn to coat and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 red bell peppers
3 (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince additional garlic; place in a large bowl along with oil, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Cut snap peas crosswise into ½-inch pieces and add to the bowl; stir to combine the salad and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates. Enjoy!
